positive_composition.notes: Specialty-mismatch positives: cardiology referral with only a PCP visit IS a gap (trap for recall).

negative_composition.note: Case counts overlap across 40 negative patients (52 listed cases distributed across 40 patients). Do not sum to derive a patient total.

hard_negative_families.name: completed_referral
hard_negative_families.description: Referral + matching consult inside the window → must not flag.

hard_negative_families.name: wrong_specialty_neighbour
hard_negative_families.description: Cardiology referral with a completed PCP visit → still a gap (positive trap), but a PCP referral satisfied by a PCP visit is not.

hard_negative_families.name: referral_inside_window
hard_negative_families.description: Referral placed recently, window not yet elapsed → must not flag.

hard_negative_families.name: explicit_series
hard_negative_families.description: Two CBCs 8 days apart both series_status=explicit_series → must not flag.

hard_negative_families.name: same_day_duplicate
hard_negative_families.description: Same-day same-provider same-test → treated as one order, must not flag.

hard_negative_families.name: imaging_different_region
hard_negative_families.description: Same modality, different body region within window → must not flag.

hard_negative_families.name: med_stopped_early
hard_negative_families.description: Medication stopped before window closed → must not flag.

hard_negative_families.name: alias_covered_monitoring
hard_negative_families.description: Lab present under an alias within window → must not flag (tests normalization).

hard_negative_families.name: boundary_monitoring
hard_negative_families.description: Lab resulted exactly on the due date → within window, must not flag.

hard_negative_families.name: malformed_event
hard_negative_families.description: Event missing source_doc_id or invalid date → dropped in validation, never becomes a gap.

matching_rule: v2: patient_id equal AND type equal AND >=1 cited source_doc_id overlap; one reported gap matches at most one ground-truth gap (greedy best overlap first).
notes: Generated manifest is canonical. No symmetry forcing. Counts are targets within the stated ranges (35-45 positive, 35-45 negative, 60-80 gaps).
